reason: The frozen v2-medium heldout run failed because Luna conflated truthful diagnostic omission with material factual error. All 28 now-exposed cases become development-only. Fourteen newly authored, independently checkable cases are reserved as the untouched v4 heldout split before any v4 model call.

reference_audit_notes.QH003: The answer explicitly fills the trigger/cause slot with an unsupported obstacle-frequency claim, so the unresolved-trigger unit is incorrect under the previously adopted proposition-slot taxonomy.
reference_audit_notes.QH006: The answer explicitly asserts that evidence is insufficient even though the supplied tolerance and terminal measurement decide the requested check; this is a contradicted completeness assertion, not a bare omission. The original failed result is unchanged.
